body:
Upstream issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/34572

Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/issues/1765

Candidate parent PR: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/1639 at `aae252eb457f1f0358ae4b98897f3a8fa6eda50d`

Independent review parent PR: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/1727

## What changed

- preserved the candidate's valid HiCache readiness and ordered immutable PP bootstrap consensus changes
- reproduced and fixed the review counterexample: an already-applied sequence is accepted only when its full `(sequence, good, bad)` decision exactly matches the last commit; divergent or older replays raise immediately
- added the missing PD router protection tracked by upstream PR 34570: only a server-selection failure before dispatch is retryable, while a response after either upstream may have been contacted is returned without replay
- added scheduler boundary regressions plus router unit/integration coverage, including an exact request-count assertion

## Failing before

At exact candidate commit `aae252eb457f1f0358ae4b98897f3a8fa6eda50d`:

```bash
PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-462148c2530d/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/managers/test_pp_abort_consensus.py
```

Result: `1 failed, 20 passed, 4 subtests passed`. Applying `PPBootstrapDecision(0, ("rid-good",), ())` and then `PPBootstrapDecision(0, (), ("rid-good",))` did not raise; the second payload was logged as a duplicate and ignored.

Source inspection independently confirmed the router counterexample: the candidate used `is_retryable_status` for every completed PD attempt, and its integration test expected a failed first decode dispatch to be automatically replayed to a second worker.

## Passing after

```bash
PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-462148c2530d/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q \
  test/registered/unit/managers/test_pp_abort_consensus.py \
  test/registered/unit/managers/test_pp_hicache_prefetch_consensus.py
```

Result: `26 passed, 4 subtests passed`.

```bash
/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-462148c2530d/venv/bin/python -m py_compile \
  python/sglang/srt/managers/scheduler_pp_mixin.py \
  python/sglang/srt/managers/io_struct.py \
  python/sglang/srt/disaggregation/prefill.py
git diff --check
```

Result: passed.

Raw commands, outputs, issue/PR snapshots, and structured claims are in `reports/j-462148c2530d/`.

## Limitations

The prepared image has no `cargo` or `rustc`; `cargo fmt --check` failed with exit 127, so the router source and Rust tests could not be compiled here. The router correction and tests follow upstream PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/34570, but no passing Rust-native result is claimed.

The assigned single gfx950 cannot reproduce the reported PP=8 disaggregated Mooncake topology. No full-model, multi-node, NCCL-watchdog, 32K shared-prefix, or seven-hour soak result is claimed. No native C++ changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
